whenToUse: Sign up, contact and checkout forms that collect a number together with its country dial code
Edit and account screens that show a saved number, either editable or read only
Single market forms that open preset to one country and format the number the local way

whenNotToUse.when: A plain tel field in one fixed national format with no country picker
A one time code sent by text message once the number is known
A complete personal details page with avatar, name, email and phone in one layout

agentNotes: Nothing validates the number; check it yourself and pass `aria-invalid` to `PhoneInput`, which turns the country button and the field red
`placeholder` is the only text naming the field in every example; tie a label to it by id, or pass an aria label
Height comes from `variant` set to `sm`, `default` or `lg`, not `size`, which stays the native input attribute
